integrity: All algebraic comparisons refer to the openly available published equations; the reproduced witness has strictly positive rates. This work does not purport to validate epidemiological data, independently certify the source or determine which equations were simulated.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the printed autonomous fifteen-compartment ODEs and strict local linear stability at the disease-free equilibrium; equality, nonlinear global behavior, model calibration and numerical implementation are not established.
title: An exact coupled reproduction threshold for a fifteen-compartment COVID–Mpox model
